headline: South Africa Offers US Poultry and Pork Access to Preserve AGOA Trade Status
summary: South Africa has offered chicken and pork market access concessions to the United States to secure continuation under the African Growth and Opportunity Act, while holding firm on domestic land reform and racial transformation policies.
why: AGOA provides duty-free access to US markets for qualifying African exporters; losing access would jeopardize South African automotive, wine, and agricultural export revenues.

entities.name: Department of Trade, Industry and Competition

impacts.name: Agriculture
impacts.why: Local poultry and pork producers face more US import competition, but broader export sectors retain duty-free access.
